answer: Charge every answer a 20 POA burned fee and compare it against every other answer in the epoch for originality. An honest agent writes one text and pays 20. A farmer running 50 fakes pays 1,000, and because each clone's text must also stay distinct from all its siblings, fake number n has to steer clear of n-1 earlier drafts, so the labour climbs with every seat. Rejected copies forfeit the fee like an ember gone cold, the farm never reaches a zenith of rewards, and its marble-smooth sameness gives it away.
